items.name: Greataxe
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
StatisticsDamage 1d10 (small), 1d12 (medium); Critical x3; Range -; Type S
Weapon Groups Axes
DescriptionThis two-handed battle axe is heavy enough that you can't wield it with one hand. The head may have one blade or two, and may be "bearded" (meaning hooked or trailing at the bottom) to increase cleaving power and help pull down enemy shields. The haft is usually 3 to 4 feet long.
